intro: Syurna is a night elf rogue trainer found nestled among the foliage of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. She mentors aspiring scouts, spies, and covert operatives of the Kaldorei, guiding newly trained rogues on missions that test their stealth and cunning.

p: While Darnassus celebrates the overt martial might of the Sentinels and the spiritual wisdom of the Sisterhood of Elune, the Kaldorei have always relied on shadows and stealth. Located in the Cenarion Enclave, Syurna acts as a trainer and mentor for those who walk an unseen path. She instructs rogues in the fine arts of evasion, lockpicking, and lethal strikes, ensuring that Darnassus possesses sharp eyes and silent blades to defend Teldrassil.

Syurna does not merely offer theoretical advice from the safety of the enclave; she tests the readiness of young operatives. Through tasks such as directing promising initiates into deeper fieldwork, she tests whether an operative has the instincts necessary to survive outside the boughs of the World Tree and serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.
